analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds a 'Focused Gemma 4 tensor-parallel checks' section (head lines ~1231-1345). The supplied units are BASE text for lines 922-1843 and contain no added lines; the new section appears only in a truncated patch excerpt. I found no code, workflow, authorization, attestation, encryption, billing or data-exposure change in the visible evidence. The new section's visible text says the checks use synthetic weights, run on one Mac over loopback, and do not qualify real-weight numerics, a pair or speed. That is honest scoping and consistent with the threat model's evidence-limit language (T-056, T-054). The unchanged base text I read states that fixture or loopback passes do not qualify hardware or production, and that local validation does not authorize deployment. No threat-model assumption looks invalidated. Limits: the rest of the new Gemma section (head ~1231-1345) was not visible past the truncated patch, and any code those documented tests reference (Gemma4TensorParallel tests, gemma-run.sh) is outside this batch. Integration should confirm that any accompanying source changes, such as tensor-parallel collectives or paired data-plane encryption, are reviewed separately, because this documentation unit alone gives no security evidence about them.
